Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: Instead of retrieving the exact edit count up to June 2023 using Wikipedia’s tools (e.g., XTools or filtered revision history), WebSurfer estimated the number by averaging edits per year and extrapolating, leading to a fabricated approximation (2,619) that does not match the correct count (2,732). This reflects failure to use appropriate time filtering and reliance on an unjustified uniform distribution assumption.
